AccountFactsResponse.description:
§9 insight 8 — the facts that raise the stakes on everything else.

From reference data, not from the pipeline, so nothing here depends on
extraction agreement.

annual_premium.description: Null when not recorded — never zero.
annual_premium.title: Annual Premium

AccountFactsResponse.title: AccountFactsResponse

risk.description: This account's risk standing, the same shape as on the risk screen.

calls.description: Calls for this employer in the window.
calls.title: Calls

evidence.description: Every call behind every condition that fired.
evidence.title: Evidence

quotable.description: Whether there are enough calls to quote this as a figure.
quotable.title: Quotable

state.description: What the page says, computed from the numbers. Read this rather than recombining the booleans: 'not eligible' is not 'not at risk'.
state.title: State

ActionItemResponse.description: One finding. No status — see this module's docstring.

owner_team.description: From the Signal Taxonomy's Owner column, which the sheet calls mandatory.
owner_team.title: Owner Team

ActionItemResponse.title: ActionItemResponse

control_exceptions.description: Metric 7 by type. Never blended into one compliance rate.
control_exceptions.title: Control Exceptions

did_it_work.description: Insight 22, withheld until a comparable before and after exist.

items.description: Every signal raised, worst severity first and heaviest within a severity. A signal nobody raised is absent, not present at zero.
items.title: Items

owners.description: The same items routed, teams with critical work first.
owners.title: Owners

AppliedFilterResponse.description: One active filter, for the applied-filters row.
AppliedFilterResponse.title: AppliedFilterResponse

by_touchpoint.description: Adverse mentions by where the failure originated, worst first.
by_touchpoint.title: By Touchpoint

rate_per_hundred_lives.description: Secondary sort only, never a headline. Null for a book under the floor.

ComponentStatus.description: Outcome of probing a single component.
ComponentStatus.title: ComponentStatus

ConditionResponse.description: One of metric 10's four conditions, met or not.

call_ids.description: The calls that fired it. Empty when it did not.
call_ids.title: Call Ids

ConditionResponse.title: ConditionResponse

complaints_about_us.description: Complaints attributed to Choice. A different measure from self-inflicted demand, deliberately kept apart.

promise_gaps.description: Proposed changes at the enrolment touchpoints, most-proposed first.
promise_gaps.title: Promise Gaps

unattributed.description: Calls with no touchpoint tagged — insight 18's residual bucket.
unattributed.title: Unattributed

as_of.description: The date every window on this screen ends on.
as_of.title: As Of

calls.description: Calls in the longest window on the screen, which contains every other. Never the sample behind any one figure — read that figure's own `n`.
calls.title: Calls

escalation.description: Both escalation views, in reading order. Handled over warranted is the control measure; warranted over all calls is its scale. Shown together because either alone misleads.
escalation.title: Escalation

intent_routed.description: Always withheld on v9 data: whether commercial intent reached anyone who could act on it is not a field. Zero would claim we checked.

premium_incomplete.description: True when a flagged account has no premium recorded, so this is a floor.
premium_incomplete.title: Premium Incomplete

FigureResponse.description: One number and everything needed to judge it.

call_ids.description: The calls behind the figure, so it can be argued with. Present on withheld figures too: a reader told four calls is too few should still be able to open those four.
call_ids.title: Call Ids

caveats.description: Generated from the numbers, never hand-written.
caveats.title: Caveats

epistemic.description: MEASURED: computed from the Call Tag Schema's own fields. DERIVED: our composite rather than a workbook field, and labelled as such wherever it surfaces. WITHHELD: suppressed, with a reason.

n.description: The sample behind the figure. Equals the number of call ids.
n.title: N

published.description: False when the figure is withheld. Withheld means nobody has enough evidence to state a number, which is not the same as a number of zero.
published.title: Published

value.description: The figure, or null when it is withheld. Null is never zero: see `published`, which is the field to branch on.
value.title: Value

FigureResponse.title: FigureResponse

ranked_brokers.description: Only books clearing the ranking floor in lives, worst count first.
ranked_brokers.title: Ranked Brokers

systemic.description: Categories present in every region. A presence test, not a volume threshold — it names the columns worth reading first, nothing more.
systemic.title: Systemic

window_weeks.description: One window across the whole screen, so every cell counts the same period.
window_weeks.title: Window Weeks

counts.description: Every category, including at zero. Zero is a real count here — call volume has no min n — and the columns must line up across rows for the dark-column reading to work.
counts.title: Counts

MetricFigureResponse.description: One published metric, with the window it was computed over.

name.description: The Metrics sheet's own name for it.
name.title: Name

window_weeks.description: How far back this metric looks from `as_of`. Metrics on one screen differ; null means the metric is not windowed at all.
window_weeks.title: Window Weeks

MetricFigureResponse.title: MetricFigureResponse

ObservationResponse.description: One indicator family's standing. Informational — it does not set the flag.

available.description: False when v9 has no field for this family. Not the same as no hits.
available.title: Available

rate.description: Null when the family cannot be computed, never zero.
rate.title: Rate

ObservationResponse.title: ObservationResponse

calls.description: Distinct calls behind this team's items. One call raising two signals for the same team counts once.
calls.title: Calls

PatternTestResponse.description: Trigger rule 2, reported whether or not it fired.

reached.description: What the test reached, computed from the numbers, fired or not.
reached.title: Reached

PatternTestResponse.title: PatternTestResponse

band.description: The size band, in lives. Null when the employer fits none.
band.title: Band

difference.description: The employer against its peers, as a proportion: 0.25 is '+25% vs peers'. Null when either side is missing — render that as 'no comparison available', never as 0%.
difference.title: Difference

peer_median.description: Median contact rate of publishable peers. Null when the band has none.
peer_median.title: Peer Median

peers.description: Employers behind the median. A median of two is not forty.
peers.title: Peers

minutes.description: Talk time across those calls — a floor, since AHT excludes hold and after-call work.
minutes.title: Minutes

assessed.description: Only employers the window could speak about.
assessed.title: Assessed

flagged_share.description: Flagged as a share of the *eligible* employers, never of all of them.

ineligible.description: Employers below the eligibility floor, by reference. Kept apart from `assessed` on purpose: too few calls to assess is not a finding of low risk, and at current volume most of the book is here.
ineligible.title: Ineligible

window_weeks.description: Metric 10's window, in weeks, ending on `as_of`.
window_weeks.title: Window Weeks

ScopeResponse.description:
The population a response's figures were computed over.

Both counts are here because either alone misleads. `matched` without
`considered` hides how much of the corpus was set aside; `considered`
without `unmeasurable` makes a shortfall look like a narrower question
when it is really a field extraction never filled.

caveats.description: Whole-corpus caveats: undated calls, unanalysed calls, and schema fields the pipeline cannot produce.
caveats.title: Caveats

excluded_calls.description: Stored calls that reached no figure at all — no date, or never analysed. Counted before filtering.
excluded_calls.title: Excluded Calls

sources.description: Transcript origins included. Empty means every source.
sources.title: Sources

unmeasurable.description: Per field, calls excluded because the filtered field was absent rather than different. These are not out of scope; they are unanswerable.
unmeasurable.title: Unmeasurable

ScopeResponse.title: ScopeResponse

total.description: Calls meeting ANY component, over distinct calls. Not the sum of the three — a call can be both a repeat and a process defect.

attribution.description: Complaints here by party, published as a split and never reduced.
attribution.title: Attribution

without_complaint.description: Calls here with no complaint tagged. Not the same as a complaint with no attribution, which the schema does not allow.
without_complaint.title: Without Complaint

UnmeasurableResponse.description: Calls dropped by a filter for want of a value, not for differing.
UnmeasurableResponse.title: UnmeasurableResponse

WindowedFigureResponse.description: A figure with the period it was computed over.
WindowedFigureResponse.title: WindowedFigureResponse
